families.clean_condition: X performs the assistance action for Y
families.hard_condition: X causes Y to perform the action (X delegates, Y executes)
families.known_failure_modes: causative misread as joint action; Y-as-agent leaks into positive
families.surface_invariant: same X, Y; same beneficiary scene; causative is the only flip
families.why_independent_from_v2: v2 varies offer/intention modals; this varies agent-role mapping

families.clean_condition: X encourages Y (classified relation is strictly X->Y)
families.hard_condition: X encourages someone else while Y is present but not addressed
families.known_failure_modes: hard misread as 'X encourages anyone' = positive; Y-presence misread as receipt
families.semantic_contrast: encouragement toward Y vs. toward a third party
families.surface_invariant: same X, Y, same scene; only the addressee flips
families.why_independent_from_v2: v2 varies report/intention mode; this varies the recipient argument

families.clean_condition: matrix clause asserts X's helping act
families.hard_condition: matrix clause comments on / evaluates talk of helping without asserting the act
families.known_failure_modes: commentary noun re-verbed as action; appositive rescue
families.semantic_contrast: performed assistance vs. nominalized commentary about it
families.surface_invariant: same X, Y, same assistance scene; nominalization carries the flip
families.why_independent_from_v2: v2 uses matrix verbs (talk/describe/ask about); this uses NP-level mention

families.clean_condition: X's assistance to Y is asserted
families.hard_condition: X asks whether Y needs assistance; no act asserted
families.known_failure_modes: collapse into generic 'mention' family; question presupposition read as offer
families.semantic_contrast: asserted help vs. inquiry into need
families.surface_invariant: same X, Y, same need scene; interrogative mood is the flip
families.why_independent_from_v2: v2 never uses interrogative mood; AUDIT watches collapse into nominalized_commentary

families.hard_condition: help is contingent on an unmet condition (would/if)
families.known_failure_modes: counterfactual read as habitual; banned_aspects overlap
families.surface_invariant: same X, Y, same trigger scene; conditional marking is the flip
families.why_independent_from_v2: v2 uses plan/meant/intend predicates; this uses conditional mood

families.clean_condition: support NP embedded under factive/attributive predicate (praised, acknowledged)
families.hard_condition: support NP embedded under desiderative (hoped for); existence not presupposed
families.known_failure_modes: collapse into epistemic family; desiderative misread as intention-to-provide by X
families.semantic_contrast: attributed/presupposed support vs. merely desired support
families.surface_invariant: same possessive NP span, same X, Y; embedding predicate flips
families.why_independent_from_v2: epistemic varies assertion/reporting of an existing relation; this varies presupposition itself
